verdict.rationale: Vestd is an equity-management SaaS that promotes some automation, such as automated Companies House filing and an HRIS integration, so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence shows user-defined automations that can be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. The admin review of option-exercise requests is an adjacent approval step, not automation versioning, so it earns no credit.
